text: AMCULUM, in Roman antiquity, a woman’s up pergermary, which differed from the pala. It was worn both by manova and courarears.

parsed.faithful: AMICULUM, in Roman antiquity, a woman's upper garment, which differed from the pala. It was worn both by matrons and courtezans.
parsed.modern: AMICULUM, in Roman antiquity, a woman's upper garment, which differed from the pala. It was worn both by matrons and courtesans.
